profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cars.com
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Developer with 9 years in the financial services industry, I have specialized in delivering production-grade features for investment platforms. My expertise spans JavaScript, React, Vue.js, TypeScript, and Azure, which I’ve utilized to develop tools such as investment dashboards and recommendation reports that enhance global research workflows and data visualization.  

Committed to enabling impactful solutions, I have contributed to cloud migration projects, optimized system performance, and designed user-centric applications. With a focus on collaboration, clear communication and clean code, I aim to drive meaningful innovation while supporting teams and businesses in achieving operational excellence.

Feel free to reach out: sheenaramirezsoftware@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - TypeScript, React, Vue.js, JavaScript, Azure
positions.description:
Led UI integration of Azure AD authentication using TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js and Microsoft Azure, enabling cloud migration for a major business unit and contributing to recurring infrastructure savings exceeding $10,000 per month.

Developed investment dashboard in TypeScript, Vue.js, AlphaSense API, AG Grid and Highcharts, delivering portfolio and market performance visualizations for approximately $30.1 billion in disclosed equity holdings.

Owned end-to-end architecture and delivery of Summit Investment Platform’s updated Recommendation Report with Figma, TypeScript, Vue.js and PrimeVue, improving primary research workflow for hundreds of stakeholders within a business managing more than $65 billion in assets.

Served as an internal resource on GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted engineering (Cursor), translating adoption practices for a 20-person development team during a major initiative to migrate Summit from Vue.js to TypeScript and React.

Revamped Summit’s data-intensive homepage using JavaScript and Vue.js, improving access to real-time and historical security trading and equity research activity within a firm of nearly 2,000 employees across 20+ global offices.

Resolved critical performance and maintainability issues to prevent $5.2M in lost revenue with TypeScript, Vue.js, Microsoft Azure, Vite, and Webpack, improving reliability across defect triage, app performance and build tooling.

Refactored column selection tool within data table feature in JavaScript, Vue.js, AG Grid and PrimeVue, streamlining customization of interactive tables displaying ~4,500 data points across 4000+ companies, reducing load times by 75%.
positions.insights: Azure DevOps Services, JavaScript and +29 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer - Vue.js, JavaScript, Azure
positions.description:
Delivered production features for Summit Investment Platform using JavaScript, Vue.js, and Microsoft Azure as part of a 15-person agile engineering team, supporting investment workflows across a business generating $2.3B annually.

Led architectural decision to introduce Vue.js into Summit ecosystem, launching adoption across 2 core JavaScript, Vue.js, AngularJS, and Framework7 applications, driving incremental migration to Vue.js.

Diagnosed and resolved high-impact production defects using JavaScript, Vue.js and MS Azure DevOps (Pipelines, Artifacts, Boards, Repos) across 5 technical layers: UI behavior, application state, authentication, APIs and data flow.

Collaborated with engineers using Git, Microsoft Azure DevOps, code reviews, asynchronous documentation and agile delivery practices after the team transitioned to fully remote work in 2020.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Vue.js, Node.js, GraphQL, JavaScript
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a full-stack enterprise web application, using Vue.js on the frontend and Node.js on the backend, to deliver macroeconomic, political risk and industry intelligence to 4,000+ clients across 114 countries.

Designed reusable frontend components and interactive data visualizations with Vue.js and Handsontable, as well as intuitive GraphQL API interfaces connected to a Node.js server, that improved users' ability to explore complex economic and market intelligence spanning 2.7 million economic data points.

Optimized performance of Fitch’s web app by migrating the frontend to Vue.js from Backbone.js, improving site responsiveness, speed and reliability for users researching 200+ global markets and 20+ industries.

positions.title: Managing Editor, Digital Publications - JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Google Analytics
positions.description:
Implemented digital strategies for the publication’s reporting team, including writing JavaScript and HTML code to highlight major news stories and troubleshoot bugs for the magazine’s website read by 414,000 unique monthly visitors and 8,100 newsletter followers.

Managed a remote team of 9 employees, assigning stories based on Google Analytics traffic statistics.

volunteerExperiences.description: 826CHI is a non-profit organization dedicated to supporting students ages 6 to 18 with their creative and expository writing skills, and to helping teachers inspire their students to write. Volunteers assist in running student programs, such as writing workshops that teach how to write memoirs or science fiction stories.
